about.title: About Us
about.p1: We are expatriates from Mokbulpur village. We save together — building a fund for our community's welfare and to stand beside neighbours when they need us.
about.p2: All contributions and expenses flow through a single transparent ledger. Every taka collected and every taka spent is openly recorded on this site. Built on trust.

whatWeDo.title: Why Saving Together Matters
whatWeDo.subtitle: Pooled monthly contributions build resilience, community trust, and a fund ready for whatever comes.
whatWeDo.securityBody: A safety net for emergencies — illness, calamity, or family hardship. No member stands alone when life turns hard.
whatWeDo.collectiveBody: Twenty hands together can build what one alone cannot — a fund that reflects our shared commitment to home.
whatWeDo.growthBody: Small monthly contributions compound into something significant — ready for the next ten years, twenty years, and beyond.
whatWeDo.transparencyBody: Every contribution and every disbursement is recorded — visible to all members, all the time.

rules.title: Rules & Policies
rules.subtitle: The constitution and operating policies of the Mokbulpur Probasi savings society.
section1List: A small 3-member committee oversees the organization — President, General Secretary, and Cashier.
The President leads meetings and decision-making.
The General Secretary handles all accounts and communications.
The Cashier collects contributions and maintains the master ledger.
No decision is made individually — every decision is based on majority consensus.
section2List: Any expatriate from Mokbulpur village may become a member.
Once enrolled, a member's record is preserved — accounts cannot be deleted.
Failing to pay 4 consecutive monthly installments, or breaking the rules, may lead to membership cancellation upon discussion.
Inactive or cancelled members remain visible in the records for transparency.
section3List: Every member pays 2,000 BDT per month.
All members pay the same amount — no exceptions.
The society's initial term is 2 years.
After 2 years, a new term can be set by collective consent at a meeting.
section4List: Installments must be paid between the 1st and 10th of every month.
After the 10th, the same month's installment will not be accepted.
If a member is genuinely unable to pay in a given month, a one-month grace period is granted.
Within the 10th of the following month, both months' installments must be paid together — no fine.
If both months remain unpaid past the 10th of the second month, a 200 BDT fine applies per missed month.
section5List: Money is not kept under any individual's name — a Joint Savings Account is opened in the organization's name.
Withdrawals require joint signatures from any 2 of the 3: President, Secretary, Cashier.
The Cashier provides a written or digital receipt for every installment received.
A master ledger holds the complete record of all transactions.
Monthly statements (total collected, expenses, bank balance) are shared with everyone via SMS or WhatsApp group.
Every transaction is also publicly visible on this website.
section6List: When meetings are called, everyone must join online.
Absence without a valid reason may incur a fine, agreed upon by all.
section7List: If a member wants to leave before the 2-year term ends, they receive their money only when funds are distributed to everyone.
Early leavers receive only their principal — no profit share.
If the member leaves for an acceptable reason, profit sharing is decided through group discussion.
section8List: No loans are given from the society fund to any member or non-member.
Society money will not be used for any public-service donations.
If a member has a serious personal or social need, they may present details to the President or in the group.
After review, members may collect funds separately (outside the society fund) to help according to ability — inshallah.
section9List: If a member dies within the 2-year term, the family decides —
If able, the family may continue the monthly installments.
Or the society may be dissolved and the saved money distributed.
section10List: If a serious complaint is raised against any committee member, the members' vote will be taken.
If the majority votes against, that person's role is revoked.
The replacement is also elected by majority vote.
rules.closingNote: These rules may be amended through collective decision of the committee and members. Any changes will be announced on this website and shared with all members.
